{{Infobox character|name=Ser Alba|house=[[House Stonebear]] (in service)|role=Sword-hand|age=~44|appears=''Thirty Marks in Old Silver'' (scene)}}
'''Ser Alba''' is [[House Stonebear]]'s sword-hand and its most reasonable voice for bending — a pragmatist who loves the house and watches its honor being weaponized against it, contract by contract.

What Oath-hold does not talk about: the shortfalls in the pass accounts have been covered twice from her own purse — her mother's farm sold, her border-commission share spent — with no oath broken and no one told. ''"Somebody was going to pay for your father's peace,"'' she told the heir once. ''"I preferred it be someone who volunteered."'' She does not lie about her own knife: ''"The first step is honest. They always are."''<ref>''Thirty Marks in Old Silver'' — a scene from Emberwold, year 396 A.U.</ref>
